name: SpamProtectionRobot
description: Anti Spam/NSFW Telegram Bot Written In Python With Telethon.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Obtain a Telegram bot oken by contacting @BotFather

NSFW_LOG_CHANNEL.description: ID of the channel where NSFW logs should be forwarded. Ex: '-123456'

SPAM_LOG_CHANNEL.description: ID of the channel where SPAM logs should be forwarded. Ex: '-123456'

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID. 6 is the official Android app; your own is at https://my.telegram.org.

API_HASH.description: Telegram API hash that belongs to API_ID.

ARQ_API_URL.description: Address of the ARQ server that scans for spam and NSFW.

SPAM_MEMORY_CACHE_MB.description: Megabytes of memory for recent spam scan results. 0 turns it off.

SPAM_DISK_CACHE_MB.description: Megabytes of the database for spam scan results of short messages. 0 turns it off. The essential-0 Heroku Postgres plan has about 1 GB in total: use 512 or less there.
